_about: The 12 moves and Ravi's lines, shared by every version (macOS, Linux, Windows). Edit here, then reinstall.

moves.name: Chin tucks
moves.desc: Slide your head straight back, like you're making a double chin. Hold for a beat.
steps: Sit tall and look straight ahead.
Glide your chin straight back. Don't tip your head down.
Hold for 3 seconds and feel the back of your neck lengthen.
Let go slowly and repeat.

moves.name: Thoracic extension
moves.desc: Hands behind your head, arch back over the top of your chair.
steps: Scoot to the back of your chair so the backrest meets your mid-back.
Lace your fingers behind your head, elbows wide.
Lean back over the backrest and look up. Keep your hips down.
Come back to upright and repeat.

moves.name: Walkaround
moves.desc: Get up and walk a lap. Refill your water. Rest your eyes.
steps: Stand up and leave the screen behind.
Walk a lap of the floor, the hallway or the kitchen.
Refill your water on the way.
Roll your shoulders a few times before you sit back down.

moves.name: Shoulder blade squeeze
moves.desc: Pull your shoulder blades back and down, as if you're pinching a pencil between them.
steps: Sit or stand tall with your arms bent at 90°.
Draw your shoulder blades together and down.
Hold for 5 seconds without shrugging.
Relax and repeat.

moves.name: Doorway chest stretch
moves.desc: Forearm on a door frame, step through until you feel it across your chest.
steps: Stand in a doorway with your forearm on the frame, elbow at shoulder height.
Step the same-side foot forward.
Turn your chest away gently until you feel a stretch.
Hold 30 seconds, then switch sides.

moves.name: Neck side stretch
moves.desc: Ear toward your shoulder, then add a light pull with the same-side hand.
steps: Sit tall and let one shoulder drop.
Tilt your ear toward the other shoulder.
Rest that hand on your head for a light pull. No yanking.
Hold 20 seconds, then switch sides.

moves.name: Stand and reach
moves.desc: Stand up, reach both arms overhead and grow tall. Lean a little to each side.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Reach both arms overhead and stretch tall.
Lean gently to one side, then the other.
Lower your arms slowly.

moves.name: Seated twist
moves.desc: Sit tall, turn your chest toward the backrest, hold, then switch.
steps: Sit tall with both feet flat on the floor.
Turn your chest to one side and hold the backrest.
Breathe out and turn a little further. Hold 5 seconds.
Return to centre and switch sides.

moves.name: Wrist and forearm stretch
moves.desc: Arm straight, palm out, gently pull your fingers back. Then palm down.
steps: Hold one arm out straight, palm facing away.
Use the other hand to ease the fingers back.
Hold 20 seconds, then turn the palm down and press the hand gently.
Switch arms if you have time.

moves.name: 20-20-20 eye break
moves.desc: Look at something about 6 metres away for 20 seconds. Blink a few times.
steps: Look away from the screen.
Find something at least 6 metres away, out of a window if you can.
Keep your focus there for 20 seconds.
Blink slowly a few times before you look back.

moves.name: Hip flexor stretch
moves.desc: Step one foot back, tuck your hips under and feel the front of the hip open.
steps: Stand and take a long step back with one foot.
Bend the front knee a little and tuck your pelvis under.
Feel the stretch at the front of the back hip. Hold 30 seconds.
Switch legs.

moves.name: Calf raises
moves.desc: Stand up, rise onto your toes, lower slowly. Hold the desk if you need to.
steps: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, hands on the desk.
Rise onto the balls of your feet.
Lower slowly over 2 seconds.
Repeat.

off: I check on you every few minutes once you start. Press P.
Nonna's orders: you sit up, I keep the time.
running: Your spine is not a croissant.
I'm stuffed with ricotta and I still sit straighter than you.
Al dente posture: firm, not stiff.
Screen at eye level. I can see you squinting.
Feet flat on the floor, please.
Breathe out. You've been holding that since lunch.
Twenty minutes is a long time to be shaped like a prawn.
paused: Taking a break from me? Rude, but fine.
Paused. I'll be right here, judging gently.
meeting: Shh. I'll wait until your meeting's over.
Look attentive. I'll hold your stretch.
held: One stretch is waiting for when your meeting ends.
skip: Skipped. I'll pretend I didn't see that.
back: Welcome back. Fresh clock from now.
You moved, I noticed. Clock starts over.
